newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: SIA, Air NZ to code-share from Nov 1.
newsitem.headline: SIA, Air NZ to code-share from Nov 1.

text.p: Singapore Airlines and Air New Zealand plan to start code-sharing on flights between Singapore and New Zealand from November 1 under a new alliance signed on Friday.
The alliance also includes Australian airline Ansett.
Singapore Airlines will operate flights between Singapore and Auckland, while Air New Zealand will operate flights between Christchurch and Singapore, the airlines said.
"A seat swap arrangement will enable both airlines to market seats on all these flights to their individual customers," they said in a statement.
The alliance boasts coverage of over 200 cities in 47 countries, operating a combined fleet of 223 aircraft.
